name: lcui
description: The C library for building user interfaces.

scripts.build-styles: node scripts/generate-accent-themes.js && lcui build src/styles/style-nova.css --force --skip-xmake && lcui build src/styles/accents --force --skip-xmake && lcui build src/styles/accent-swatches.css --force --skip-xmake
scripts.build-accents: node scripts/generate-accent-themes.js && lcui build src/styles/accents --force --skip-xmake && lcui build src/styles/accent-swatches.css --force --skip-xmake
scripts.doc-viewer:compile-docs: npm run doc-viewer:stars && cd examples/doc-viewer && npm run compile
scripts.doc-viewer:compile-tsx: npm run doc-viewer:stars && cd examples/doc-viewer && lcui build --force --skip-xmake

author: Liu Chao <hello@lcui.dev> (https://lcui.dev)
